name: Hypertree Consecutiveness
definition: Two hypertrees H and H' are rectilinearly consecutive for component k (denoted H ≺ H' when d ≠ 3) if the outside boundary of H ∪ H' is a line segment (d=1), rectangle (d=2), or rectangular prism (d=3) with the same origin, orientation, and size vector as H, except for the k-th component which is sum of their k-size vectors.
